mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with partly cloudy skies near the Verona Public Library. If you look up tonight, the International Space Station will be visible starting at 6:34 PM, traveling from over Cross Plains toward the Madison area near Home Depot.

The City of Verona is inviting residents to a public meeting on December 8 at the Verona Senior Center to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, which includes bridge replacements and trail improvements from Old CTH PB to Wildcat Way.
While there are no events scheduled for the next 30 days, we encourage you to keep an eye on city announcements for upcoming community gatherings.

In our weekly report, on October 25, officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where a 40-year-old man was found behind the wheel of a parked car for 20 minutes and was subsequently arrested for an O W I offence.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's of Verona is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by anytime before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
